It's widely used for building enterprise-level applications, mobile apps, and the backend of web-based services. Java applications are compiled to bytecode, which can run on any machine with a Java Virtual Machine (JVM). This allows Java-based applications to be distributed easily and run on any platform, from desktops to servers. Java's strong type system, garbage collection, and platform independence make it a popular choice for developing large-scale applications and games.

React.js is a popular JavaScript library for building user interfaces. It's used to create reusable UI components that can be combined to build complex applications. React.js uses a virtual DOM to improve performance by updating parts of the UI rather than the entire page. It also uses a component-based architecture that allows for easier code organization and reusability. React.js is widely used for building dynamic web applications, mobile apps, and desktop apps. It's also used for building games and other front-end projects.
